capabilities: Merge, deduplicate and sort tags on the current line
Search a note or the whole vault for lines containing all entered tags
Add tags to a file name and rename the file
Search file names by tag substrings
Step through results in a sidebar view
disambiguation: Not only a search tool; it also rewrites tags on the current line and renames files to add tags.
extras: Obsidian cannot ship default hotkeys, so commands must be bound manually; vault-wide search reads files through the Obsidian API instead of ripgrep, so it works on mobile.
intentEvidence: Ports five tag-related features from the Neovim plugin rookie_tag.nvim to Obsidian.
motivation: To bring five tag-related features from the Neovim plugin rookie_tag.nvim to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to search notes by combined tags, rewrite a line's tags, or add tags to file names.

relations.evidence: Ports five tag-related features from the Neovim plugin rookie_tag.nvim to Obsidian.

summary: Port of five tag features from a Neovim plugin: merge and sort tags on a line, search tags in a note or vault, and tag or search file names.
